name: autonear-video
description: Remotion hackathon demo video for AutoNEAR (separate from the app's dependencies)

scripts.render: npm run verify && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/autonear-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:cine: npm run verify:cine && remotion render src/index.ts Cinematic out/autonear-cinematic.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:cine2: node scripts/verify.mjs --variant=cine2 && tsc --noEmit && remotion render src/index.ts Cinematic2 out/autonear-cinematic-v2.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.build: npm run capture && npm run tts && npm run audio && npm run render
scripts.render:dm: node scripts/verify.mjs --variant=dm && tsc --noEmit && remotion render src/index.ts ProductDemoV3 out/autonear-product-demo-v3.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:pd: node scripts/verify.mjs --variant=pd && tsc --noEmit && remotion render src/index.ts ProductDemo out/autonear-product-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
